_readme: The example week on /partners/here-together. Nothing here is confirmed. Each day has 'daytime' and 'evening' lists. An empty list [] shows 'Open for partner programming'. null means closed for that part of the day. 'closed' on a day replaces both. Each session: time, title, type (making|show|kids|spectacle|community|students), description, audience[], runBy, tags[] (any of: makers, openings, kids, spectacle, students, sponsors).
